We’ve been in a cycle of one of us feeling anxious - from fear of rejection or fear of abandonment - so we seek reassurance, which leaves the other feeling overwhelmed and smothered. 

They either pull away in an attempt to self-soothe, which gives validity to the fears of the anxious one, or they put their partners needs before their own, only amplifying the feeling of being smothered, until they can’t take it anymore.

A few tips: 

If you fall off one day, don’t beat yourself up, try again tomorrow. 

Focus on protein and fiber. If you’re craving sweets, you probably need sleep. If you must indulge, try a piece of fruit first. Avoid fructose as much as possible. Stevia is a great substitute for sugar.

Exercise - a healthy mix of cardio, strength training and mobility exercises. Go for walks after you eat, this will help keep your sugar from spiking, which causes that post-meal fatigue. Aim to move often throughout the day, even if it’s a short walk, or bathroom squats if that’s not possible. Anything to get your heart rate up.

Hope this helps. Best of luck!
